---
name: Documentation request
about: Report incorrect, missing, unclear, or outdated project documentation
title: "[DOCS] "
labels: ["documentation", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Documentation location
File path and section heading:

## Problem
Explain what is missing, inaccurate, contradictory, or difficult to follow.

## Current behavior or text
Quote the relevant wording or describe the mismatch with actual source code.

## Expected documentation
Explain what the reader should be able to understand or complete.

## Type
- [ ] Missing guide
- [ ] Incorrect setup command
- [ ] Incorrect environment variable
- [ ] Route or architecture mismatch
- [ ] Provider integration mismatch
- [ ] Firestore schema/rules mismatch
- [ ] Security or privacy gap
- [ ] Broken relative link
- [ ] Other

## Suggested correction
Provide proposed structure or wording where possible.

## Validation
Explain how the revised content can be checked against the code. Do not document planned behavior as implemented.
